doc: Client -> server. TEXT part of the header seen on the wire. The very next message on the wire MUST be a binary PCM16 body (see audio_frame_binary spec below). The server stores the header as pending and clears it only when the following binary is consumed; a second text header while pending is rejected.

binary_spec.note: 640 = (16000 * 0.020) * 1 channel * 2 bytes/sample. Payload must be non-empty and even byte length.

schema.sequence: int >= 0, starts at 0 and increments by 1 per frame
